newsitem.title: JAPAN: Four hurt in Hiroshima dynamite plant explosions.
newsitem.headline: Four hurt in Hiroshima dynamite plant explosions.

text.p: At least four people were injured when two explosions rocked a dynamite plant in Hiroshima on Tuesday, authorities said.
The explosions at Chugoku Kayaku Corp in Hiroshima, 690 km (430 miles) southwest of Tokyo, occurred at 2.20 p.m. (0520 GMT), they said.
Fire fighters said at least four workers were injured in the blasts and urged residents near the plant to evacuate their homes.
A spokesman for Chugoku Kayaku said the explosions were in a room where TNT (trinitrotoluene), the key ingredient of dynamite, is produced.

"Windows shook because of the sound of the explosions. Black smoke was seen coming out from the plant," said a staff member at a nearby school run by the Japanese navy, or Maritime Self-Defence Force.
In April, three workers were killed in explosions at the complex, which produces dynamite and other explosives, mainly for Japan's military.
